annotations.title: Read what a run actually did

description: List your Traces — the durable record of what a run DID, newest first. This is                  the other half of rig_run: a run reports that it started, and the trace is where                  the answer lands. Without it an agent can run a rig and never learn whether it                  worked, which makes the run untestable. Filter by `rig_id` (this rig's runs),                  `parent_trace_id` (the STEPS under one run — this is how you see which steps ran                  and which were skipped by a guard), `trace_kind` ('run' for the containers,                  'atomic' for individual steps) or `status`. Owner-scoped: you see only your own.                  Requires Authorization: Bearer <JWT>.

parent_trace_id.description: The atomic step traces under one run — how you see which steps actually ran.

name: trace_search
